title: The Fated Invitation
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to present his conditions, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently—a warning from Mo Xiansheng: Old Sect Leader Ling Yuan had personally set out.

text.content: Night wind like blades, the Demonic Path main camp's lights flickering in the distance, stretching Chen Ji's shadow into something grotesque and lonely. His fingers gripping the fragment had gone pale, his chest compressed as if by an enormous stone, so heavy he could barely breathe. "From birth..." His voice was dry and hoarse. "Are you saying that from the moment I was in my mother's womb, I was your chess piece?"

dialogue.content: "Chess piece?" The voice carried a faintly indifferent mockery. "No, you are the chess player chosen by fate. It is just that at that time, you were not qualified to move the pieces."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, memories surging like a tide. At seven years old, his father suddenly proposed breaking off the engagement—the reason was absurdly ridiculous: "This child is born with a crippled spiritual pulse, incompatible with our Xiao family." The Xiao family, once an equal of the Chen family, had trampled him into the dust at the age when he needed dignity most.

He thought it was his family's abandonment for poverty, the standard script of worldly coldness. But now that he thought about it, his father's gaze at the time had been too calm, as if he had known this day would come. And the Xiao family... their decline began from rejecting him. That was not humiliation, but protection. Protecting him from being drawn into the whirlpool too early.

dialogue.content: "That turtle shell artifact," the voice continued, "I had it buried in your Chen family's ancestral land. Your father thought it was an ancestral blessing, not knowing it was a key to awakening prepared for the Heavenly Fate bearer."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. His hand trembled slightly in his sleeve—turtle shell... that turtle shell that led him into cultivation, he had always thought it was his own fortune, the standard golden finger for a废物 to turn the tables. So from the very beginning, it was bait placed on the chessboard by someone else.

"Then what about Su Qingyao?" His voice suddenly became very light, as if squeezed from between his teeth. "She appeared at the Tianqing Sect, entered the Inner Sect, became the Senior Fellow—were all these your arrangements?"

dialogue.content: "She is the most interesting variable on the chessboard." The voice carried a hint of playfulness. "The chess piece I arranged was dyed with different colors by her own will. Do you think she looked at you favorably just because you played the废物 persona well?"

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He thought of the scrutinizing gaze when Su Qingyao first looked at him, of how she stood毫不犹豫地 in front of him in the secret realm, of every "coincidence" where she appeared precisely when he needed her. Those details he thought were his successful scheming had been woven by someone from the very beginning.

"Destiny twins..." he murmured. "You're talking about Chen Nian?" When this name left his mouth, his eyes slightly reddened. That long-missing sister, the girl taken away by the Holy Sect—she was not just a kidnapped hostage, but the key to this chess game.

dialogue.content: "Correct." The voice rarely carried a hint of solemnity. "You siblings are the two sides of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Without you, she cannot awaken; without her, your foresight will always have blind spots. The Heavenly Eye... knew this even earlier than me."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile was very faint, yet it carried an indescribable cold chill. "So my废物逆袭, my pride in thinking I turned the tables on my own—were these nothing more than a step-by-step script in your eyes? My得意 in having foresight, was I merely calculating what you allowed me to see?"

dialogue.content: "No." The voice suddenly became solemn. "I arranged the chessboard, but the moves have always been my own. You may be angry, you may feel wronged, but one thing cannot be denied—I have never made a single decision for you."

text.content: This sentence was like a basin of cold water poured over his heart. Chen Ji was stunned. He thought of those years of struggle—gritting his teeth to persist through countless nights, clenching his teeth to not retreat at the brink of life and death, biting his teeth to push on when everyone had given up. Those choices were indeed his own. The turtle shell could give him ability, but he himself pushed that ability to its extreme. The Tianji Record could give him foresight, but he himself decided every time to risk his Heavenly Fate Value.

"You are just using me." His voice was low. "Using me against the Heavenly Eye, using me to break the Holy Sect's monopoly. Your so-called cooperation is merely changing me from someone else's chess piece to yours."

dialogue.content: "Yes and no." The voice carried a meaningful implication. "What the Heavenly Eye wants is to reclaim all Heavenly Fate power, returning the world to its absolute control. What I want is to break this monopoly. Our goals align, that's all."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath. Angry? Of course he was angry. Being manipulated in life made him feel disgusted and humiliated. But he was even more aware that at this moment, he had no capital to turn hostile. To oppose the Heavenly Eye required allies, and this entity before him, at least for now, shared the same enemies.

choice.prompt: Facing this arranged fate, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Accept cooperation, endure hardship and bide time

choices.risk_hint: May continue to be manipulated, lose the self

text.content: "Cooperation can be done." Chen Ji's voice returned to calm, a calm that comes after experiencing storms. "But I have conditions."

text.content: "I don't need a pawn position as charity." Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his eyes flashing. "I, Chen Ji, am either a chess player, or—I will not be in this game."

choices.text: Make the best of the situation, mutual benefit

choices.visible_reward: Gain resources from two fronts, maneuver between multiple forces

text.content: "Cooperation..." Chen Ji laughed lightly. "Fine. But I have my own chessboard too. Since you call me a chess player, let's see who can really play this game."

Silence spread through the night. Chen Ji's breathing was very light, his heartbeat like drums. He knew his answer would determine many things, but he was even more aware—no matter who the other party is, no matter how powerful, he Chen Ji has never been a pawn to be manipulated.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." That voice finally sounded again, carrying an indescribable implication. "I果然 did not misjudge you. Then state your conditions, Heavenly Fate bearer."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze calm as water, but a faint arc curved at the corner of his mouth. In this moment, he was no longer the pitiful wretch whose fate was manipulated by others, but the one who walked out of ruins and turned the tables in desperation—the Chess Player.
